direct_claims: The chart is from a CHI 2020 research paper studying user awareness of Online Status Indicators (OSIs) across popular applications.
It specifically compares user awareness of OSIs in apps like Discord and MyFitnessPal.
The study surveyed participants about the top 15 most popular apps (used by at least 10% of participants) to see if they knew whether these apps featured OSIs.
The chart shows that awareness of OSIs varies significantly by app; for example, Discord users are highly aware of its OSIs, whereas MyFitnessPal users are largely unaware that the app has them.
This discrepancy is likely driven by the design and visibility of the OSIs themselves.
